observation.visible_scene: A woman in a teal sports bra, light-gray leggings and white sneakers stands on a patterned exercise mat in a bright room with large multi-pane windows on the left and a plain white wall on the right. A flat resistance band is looped around her upper back/shoulders and gripped in both hands at the front. Small dumbbells (pink near the mat, purple and green to the right) lie on the concrete floor. The framing and background elements stay fixed, indicating a stationary camera.
visible_changes: Both hands are raised with elbows bent near head/shoulder height at the start, and the band runs roughly horizontally across her upper chest.

Over the middle of the clip the hand on the viewer's-right side rises toward the side of her head/ear while the viewer's-left hand drops to about shoulder height, so the band tilts into a diagonal line across her torso.
This asymmetric, slanted-band posture is held for many frames with small up-and-down oscillations of the hands rather than one clean sweep.
Near the end the viewer's-right hand lowers and both hands return to a more symmetric raised position with the band again closer to horizontal, resembling the opening pose.
Her feet, legs and standing position on the mat remain essentially unchanged throughout; only the arms, hands, band tension/angle and slight torso/head orientation move.
The dumbbells, mat and background do not move.
outside_clip_unknowns: The exercise name, intended rep scheme, and whether this excerpt is mid-rep, between reps, or at the start/end of a set.
What the woman does before t=0 and after t≈2.67s.
The anchor point / full path of the band behind her back.
uncertain_details: Exact vertical positions of each hand frame-to-frame are hard to read at this resolution; the description of 'higher' vs 'lower' is approximate.
Whether the hand motion is a single continuous arc or several small repeated movements cannot be resolved from the sampled frames.
Any very subtle body sway or camera drift is not clearly supported by the background, which appears static.
